# Brookswood Automotive LTD

> Trusted local garage in Fareham, Hampshire — trading as Fareham MOT Centre — offering MOT tests, car servicing and vehicle repairs with over 20 years of experience.

## About
Brookswood Automotive LTD, trading as Fareham MOT Centre, is an independent garage on Hackett Way in Fareham. With more than 20 years of experience, the team focuses on honest, plain-English advice, quality workmanship and transparent pricing. The garage holds a 5.0-star Google rating from 71 reviews and never carries out work without the customer's approval.

## Services
- MOT Testing: DVSA-approved Class 4 MOT tests with free retests on qualifying repairs.
- Car Servicing: Interim and full servicing using quality parts, protecting your warranty.
- Brakes: Pad, disc, calliper and brake fluid repairs and replacements.
- Suspension & Steering: Shock absorber, spring, bush and steering component repairs.
- Exhausts: Silencer, catalytic converter and DPF repairs and replacements.
- Clutches: Clutch diagnosis and full clutch kit replacement.
- Diagnostics: Electronic fault-code reading and warning-light diagnosis.
- Tyres: Supply and fitting of budget to premium tyres, puncture repairs and balancing.
- Wheel Alignment: Precision tracking and alignment to reduce tyre wear.
- Alloy Wheel Repair: Kerb damage, scuff and corrosion refurbishment.
- Car Body Repair: Dent, scratch and panel repairs with colour-matched refinishing.

## Service Areas
Fareham and the surrounding Hampshire area, including Portchester, Titchfield, Stubbington, Whiteley, Gosport and Portsmouth.
